verdict.rationale: A government filing service could plausibly offer a test or sandbox filing environment, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode or non-production environment, and the probes found no API surface at all. The fee and franchise-tax calculators are estimation tools, not isolated test environments, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
